publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.5.17 fixes the practice-target action so it opens a monitor form that saves. Monitor and Locations views explain when an assigned checker, including this computer, stops reporting and how to restart it; enabled alert destinations receive a checker-stopped warning. Run now explains when no location is checking. Responder members have a working Settings > Alerts page; the console names the signed-in person and role, with unavailable controls hidden or explained. Saving an alert destination explains the second sign-in step before enrollment or verification, retains the entered destination, and offers copy/download for issued recovery codes. Member removal names the person in a confirmation and explains why the last owner cannot be removed. Pingdom import previews provide a downloadable field report for every supplied field, distinguish source checks from resource rows and TLS companions, and document saved-response and synthetic-capture limits in docs/migrating-pingdom.md. Synthetic captures prove saved-file behavior, not live extraction or cutover. TMS scripts/recordings, Page Speed, relationships and history remain unconverted; imported definitions stay paused and credentials require local re-entry. Native Uptime Playwright steps remain visible in import previews. The exact @runeditrun/rer 0.2.121 pin is unchanged from 0.5.16. No database migration or new required setting is added: 91 SQL migration files before and after, none added, changed or removed. Monitors, history, incidents, destinations and private settings are retained on upgrade. Back up first through Settings > Backup and files > Download backup with a second factor verified within five minutes. Keep private settings and .rer/deploy separately, plus a hosted database backup. Local CLI export requires the verified UPTIME_ACCESS_COOKIE described in the backup guide; keep it private. Update with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, stop dev or preview and deploy as usual. Keep the deployment receipt and installation keys; do not rotate keys for this upgrade. The mail enable/disable commands and legacy SendGrid selector guidance under 0.5.16 remain applicable. Earlier known issues and upgrade cautions remain, including old heartbeat output, UptimeRobot monitor CSV import, erased-people restore, empty company decision feeds, the 64 KiB response-body bound and unestablished large-scale archive operation. The product screenshot was taken on 0.4.0, before the console changes of 0.5.0 through 0.5.17; it is not a new 0.5.17 capture.
